hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Find the top three longest calls for incoming and outgoing types along with contact names formatted as HH:MM:SS.

hints.title: Window Partitioning
hints.text: Join Calls with Contacts on contact identifier and use rank partitioned by call type descending by duration.

hints.title: Formatting and Ordering
hints.text: Filter where rank is at most three. Convert seconds to HH:MM:SS using floor and modulo with zero padding, ordering by type descending, duration descending, and first name descending.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RankedCalls AS (
  SELECT 
    Contacts.first_name, 
    Calls.type, 
    Calls.duration, 
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Calls.type ORDER BY Calls.duration DESC) AS call_rank
  FROM Calls
  INNER JOIN Contacts 
    ON Calls.contact_id = Contacts.id
)
SELECT 
  first_name, 
  type, 
  CONCAT(
    LPAD(FLOOR(duration / 3600), 2, '0'), ':',
    LPAD(FLOOR((duration % 3600) / 60), 2, '0'), ':',
    LPAD(FLOOR(duration % 60), 2, '0')
  ) AS duration_formatted
FROM RankedCalls
WHERE call_rank <= 3
ORDER BY type DESC, duration DESC, first_name DESC;
```

complexity.notes: Partition ranking by type followed by duration sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per call type lead to quadratic execution time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for window rank computation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use window ranking functions and format seconds into HH:MM:SS accurately.

WITH RankedCalls AS (
  SELECT 
    Contacts.first_name, 
    Calls.type, 
    Calls.duration, 
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Calls.type ORDER BY Calls.duration DESC) AS call_rank
  FROM Calls
  INNER JOIN Contacts 
    ON Calls.contact_id = Contacts.id
)
SELECT 
  first_name, 
  type, 
  TO_CHAR(duration * INTERVAL '1 second', 'HH24:MI:SS') AS duration_formatted
FROM RankedCalls
WHERE call_rank <= 3
ORDER BY type DESC, duration DESC, first_name DESC;

solutions.approach: Window Partition Rank and HH:MM:SS Duration Formatting
solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def find_longest_calls(contacts: pd.DataFrame, calls: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = calls.merge(contacts, left_on='contact_id', right_on='id', how='inner')
    if merged.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=['first_name', 'type', 'duration_formatted'])
        
    merged['call_rank'] = merged.groupby('type')['duration'].rank(method='min', ascending=False)
    filtered = merged[merged['call_rank'] <= 3].copy()
    
    def fmt(sec):
        h = sec // 3600
        m = (sec % 3600) // 60
        s = sec % 60
        return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
        
    filtered['duration_formatted'] = filtered['duration'].apply(fmt)
    filtered = filtered.sort_values(by=['type', 'duration', 'first_name'], ascending=[False, False, False])
    return filtered[['first_name', 'type', 'duration_formatted']]
